quality_assessment: Chapter is completely empty and needs to be written from scratch. All configuration file functionality is missing from documentation.

issues.description: No documentation of RIPGREP_CONFIG_PATH environment variable
issues.should_add: Document that users must set RIPGREP_CONFIG_PATH environment variable to enable config file support. Explain that ripgrep does not auto-discover config files in predetermined locations.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section explaining: 1) Config files are not loaded by default, 2) Must set RIPGREP_CONFIG_PATH to file path, 3) Empty value disables config loading, 4) Show example: export RIPGREP_CONFIG_PATH="$HOME/.ripgreprc"

issues.description: No documentation of config file syntax and parsing rules
issues.should_add: Document the two-rule format: 1) Every line is a shell argument after trimming whitespace, 2) Lines starting with # are comments (optionally preceded by whitespace)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add detailed section on config file syntax with rules: one argument per line, no escaping, lines are verbatim arguments, # for comments, whitespace trimming, empty lines allowed
issues.source_reference: crates/core/flags/config.rs:78-102 - parse_reader() function implements parsing logic

issues.should_add: Provide comprehensive example showing various flag types: flags with values (--max-columns=150), multi-line format for flags with values, comments, custom types (--type-add), color configuration, common settings
issues.fix_suggestion: Include the example from GUIDE.md lines 565-590 which demonstrates: max-columns with preview, type-add for web files, --hidden flag, glob patterns, color configuration, smart-case

issues.description: No explanation of how config file flags interact with command-line flags
issues.should_add: Explain that config file arguments are prepended to CLI arguments, so CLI flags override config file settings. Later flags override earlier ones.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section explaining precedence: config file args come first, CLI args come after, later flags win. Example: config has --max-columns=150, CLI --max-columns=0 overrides it to unlimited.
issues.source_reference: crates/core/flags/parse.rs:100-103 - Config args are prepended; GUIDE.md:610-614 - Explains override behavior

issues.description: No documentation of --no-config flag to disable config file loading
issues.should_add: Document --no-config flag that prevents reading configuration files and ignores RIPGREP_CONFIG_PATH. Useful for ensuring clean runs without config influence.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section on --no-config: prevents all config file reading, ignores RIPGREP_CONFIG_PATH, disables future auto-discovery features if added
issues.source_reference: crates/core/flags/defs.rs:4276-4307 - NoConfig flag implementation; crates/core/flags/parse.rs:87-91 - Early exit when --no-config is set

issues.description: No guidance on troubleshooting config file issues
issues.should_add: Explain that --debug flag shows which config file was loaded and what arguments were read from it. Helpful for diagnosing config issues.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add troubleshooting section: use --debug to see config file path and parsed arguments, check RIPGREP_CONFIG_PATH value, verify file exists and is readable
issues.source_reference: crates/core/flags/config.rs:41-45 - Debug logging of config args; GUIDE.md:616-619 - Mentions --debug for config debugging

issues.description: No explanation of how to format flags with values
issues.should_add: Explain two valid formats for flags with values: 1) --flag=value on one line, 2) --flag on one line, value on next line. Explain why --flag value on one line doesn't work (parser sees value as separate argument).
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section on formatting flags with values: show both --max-columns=150 and two-line format, explain why space-separated doesn't work in config files, note it's purely stylistic preference
issues.source_reference: GUIDE.md:592-601 - Explains the two valid formats and why they work

issues.description: No documentation of what happens when config file has errors
issues.should_add: Explain that ripgrep reports errors for individual lines but continues parsing. File read errors prevent all config loading. Invalid UTF-8 handling differs by platform (Unix allows, Windows rejects).
issues.fix_suggestion: Add error handling section: parse errors reported per line with line numbers, file not found stops config loading, invalid UTF-8 platform-dependent behavior
issues.source_reference: crates/core/flags/config.rs:26-47 - Error handling in args() and parse(); config.rs:104-170 - Tests showing error behavior

issues.description: No guidance on when/why to use config files vs aliases
issues.should_add: Explain that config files are useful when shell aliases aren't convenient, for setting project-specific defaults, or for complex configurations that are hard to maintain as aliases.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add introductory section on when to use config files: cross-shell consistency, complex multi-flag configurations, project-specific settings, avoiding cluttering shell configs
issues.source_reference: GUIDE.md:543-545 - Mentions config files solve issues when shell aliases aren't convenient

issues.description: No cross-reference to FAQ entry about config files
issues.should_add: Add reference to FAQ section on configuration files for quick answers
issues.fix_suggestion: Include link to FAQ.md#config at beginning or end of chapter
issues.source_reference: FAQ.md:32-37 - FAQ entry points to GUIDE.md configuration section
